title: Report: Xiaohongshu Fully Invests in AI, Bringing It from the Backstage to the Forefront to Compete in AI Social Media
excerpt: According to Sina Technology, Xiaohongshu is accelerating its AI strategy comprehensively, focusing on AI social products and AI community interaction tools. It
content_html:
According to Sina Technology, Xiaohongshu is accelerating its AI strategy comprehensively, focusing on AI social products and AI community interaction tools. It has shifted from backend technical applications to front-end self-research, productization, and ecosystem development. A source revealed that Xiaohongshu is offering high salaries to attract AI talents, especially those with strong AI-native product thinking, to invest in the independent R&D of a series of AI products. According to job platforms, the salary for the "AI Social Product Manager" position ranges from 30,000 to 60,000 yuan per month, with 16 pay periods, and the maximum annual salary can reach 960,000 yuan, showing its determination to strengthen its presence in the AI social field.

The responsibilities of this position include leading the design and development of AI companion products, exploring in-depth applications of AI in dimensions such as emotional connection, interest matching, and personalized interaction, and building a warm AI companion experience. At the same time, Xiaohongshu is also recruiting a "Comment Interaction AI Product Manager," aiming to deeply embed AI capabilities into the community ecosystem through functions like AI comments, AI character interaction, and smart replies. This position also offers a maximum annual salary of 960,000 yuan. The simultaneous recruitment of these two core positions outlines Xiaohongshu's dual-line AI strategy: one focusing on companionship and the other on community penetration.

Organizational Upgrades and Technical Reserves Go Hand in Hand

Xiaohongshu's AI transformation has had hints before. In May this year, the company announced an internal letter about a new organizational upgrade, with core changes including the establishment of an AI-level department called Dots and the Enterprise Intelligence Department, significantly increasing investment in AI from both product technology and organizational structure aspects. This adjustment marks the elevation of AI from a supporting tool to a strategic business direction, with a significant increase in the priority of resource allocation and talent recruitment.

content_html_zh:
据新浪科技报道，小红书正在全面加速AI战略，重点发力AI社交产品和AI社区互动工具。 从后端技术应用转向前端自研、产品化、生态发展。 消息人士透露，小红书正在开出高薪，吸引人工智能人才，尤其是具有较强AI原生产品思维的人才，投入自主研发一系列人工智能产品。 据招聘平台介绍，“AI社交产品经理”职位的薪资范围为每月3万至6万元，有16个付薪期，最高年薪可达96万元，显示了其加强在AI社交领域的决心。

该职位的职责包括主导AI伴侣产品的设计和开发，探索AI在情感连接、兴趣匹配、个性化交互等维度的深度应用，打造温馨的AI伴侣体验。 同时，小红书还招聘“评论互动AI产品经理”，旨在通过AI评论、AI角色互动、智能回复等功能，将AI能力深度嵌入社区生态。 该职位还提供最高年薪96万元。 这两个核心岗位的同时招聘，勾勒出小红书的双线AI战略：一是陪伴，二是社区渗透。

组织升级与技术储备齐头并进

小红书的AI转型此前已有过暗示。 今年5月，公司公布了新的组织升级内部信，核心变化包括成立AI级部门Dots和企业智能部，从产品技术和组织架构两方面大幅加大对AI的投入。 此次调整，标志着人工智能从支撑工具上升为战略性业务方向，资源配置和人才引进的优先级大幅提升。
